source: NHANES 1999-2004 public-use files (CDC, public domain): DEMO, BMX, BIX (50 kHz BIA, HYDRA 4200), DXA and DIQ; adults 18-49 y with measured DXA; complete cases on every column; convenience sample, survey weights ignored
design: case-enriched: every participant with DIQ010 = 1 (doctor-diagnosed diabetes) and complete data, plus a seeded random draw of DIQ010 = 2 up to n_requested; NOT representative of prevalence
